svg.title: Compressed-air demand and pressure recovery
svg.desc: Illustrative supply and demand timeline above pressure traces for 80 and 120 US gallons. The smaller-volume trace stops at 80 psig after 21.8 seconds. The larger completes the burst and recovers in 60 seconds.

g.text: 80 gal reaches the floor after 21.8 s.
120 gal ends the burst at 81.7 psig; recovery takes 60 s.
The burst uses 20 reference ft³; a 20-cfm margin restores it.
Flow reference: 1 atm, 20°C · tank: 20°C · pressure band: 20 psi

a.text: Method: DOE sourcebook, Fact Sheet 6, p. 43 · AI-assisted analysis
